Teacher gave vessels as extra organs in circulatory system, showing heart is not alone.
Teacher ne cell se tissue aur tissue se organ ka sequence clear example se samjhaya, ab order confident hai.

end.summary:
Practised the difference between tissue, organ, and organ system.
Used heart, blood, blood vessels, stomach, and intestines as examples.
Ordered the levels as cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Gave examples for human and plant organisation levels; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs work together in organ systems. Yash used heart, blood vessels, stomach, and intestines to explain examples, and later corrected the mix-up that the heart is one organ rather than the whole circulatory system. At home, ask Yash to make a five-step arrow diagram and label one human and one plant example at each level.
